reason: A DeepSeek Harness interface plugin that adds a right-edge message index for previewing, navigating, and loading conversation history.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 对话界面添加消息索引轨道，支持悬停预览、点击跳转和按需加载较早的历史消息。
summaries.en: Adds a message index rail to DeepSeek Harness conversations with hover previews, click-to-jump navigation, and on-demand loading of older history.

capabilities: Displays an indexed rail for user messages in the conversation view
Previews message time and text on hover
Jumps to loaded messages and loads older history to reach unloaded targets
Reads conversation messages from in-memory sessions or persisted session logs
Provides a local API endpoint for message data and injects a browser overlay
